description:
Designer & management software for xTool laser cutters & engravers.


This release focuses on improving the first-time setup, printing stability, rotary attachment workflows, roll printing, and multi-device workflows for the O1 Omni Printer.
Key Updates
- Key update: Improved the first-time setup flow, including ink loading, white ink circulation, nozzle checks, and error handling.
- Improved full-wrap printing, white ink uniformity on tapered objects, and horizontal seam lines in roll printing.
- Improved rotary attachment leveling, height measurement, alignment, handle avoidance, and canvas size calculation.
- Enhanced calibration printing with more reliable cover-open pause, failure interruption, and error prompts.
- Enhanced multi-device workflows with support for more devices, size validation, manual alignment, and device assignment guidance.
- Added alerts for consumable issues, maintenance fluid switching, and UV/DTG protection.
- Support multi-device workflow — print-then-cut between the O1 and P2, P2S, and M2
